# City of North Charleston

> Municipal government portal for North Charleston, South Carolina, providing access to city services, departments, permits, public safety, recreation, and community information.

North Charleston's official website serves as the central hub for residents and businesses to access government services, report issues, pay bills, apply for permits, and stay informed about city events and ordinances. The site integrates multiple department portals including Police, Fire, Parks & Recreation, and Cultural Arts.

## Key Topics

- City Council
- Municipal Services
- Building Permits & Inspections
- Public Works
- Planning & Zoning
- Community Safety
- Parks & Recreation
- Finance & Taxes
- Code Enforcement
- City Departments
- Ordinances
- North Charleston Police Department
- Fire Department
- Cultural Arts
- Permits & Licenses

## City Government & Administration

- [City of North Charleston Homepage](https://northcharleston.org): City of North Charleston homepage with government services, news, events, and municipal information.
- [City Council](https://northcharleston.org/government/city_council/index.php): City Council: government structure, members, ordinances, and municipal administration.
- [City Council Members and Districts](https://northcharleston.org/government/city_council/city_council_members_and_districts.php): City Council members, districts, elected officials, and contact information.
- [Committees, Boards and Commissions](https://northcharleston.org/government/city_council/committees_boards_and_commissions.php): City committees, boards, commissions, meeting schedules, and appointments.
- [City Administration & Executive Office](https://northcharleston.org/government/city_departments/executive.php): City Administration: Mayor's office, economic development, and executive departments.

## Public Safety & Emergency Services

- [North Charleston Police Department](https://police.northcharleston.org): North Charleston Police Department: crime reporting, safety, and public services.
- [North Charleston Fire Department](https://fire.northcharleston.org): North Charleston Fire Department: emergency response, inspections, and fire prevention.
- [North Charleston Municipal Court](https://northcharleston.org/government/city_departments/court/index.php): North Charleston Municipal Court procedures, ticket payment, and appeal information.

## Permits, Planning & Development

- [Building Inspections](https://northcharleston.org/government/city_departments/building_inspections.php): Building Inspection Department: permits, codes, and construction compliance guidance.
- [Planning and Zoning](https://northcharleston.org/government/city_departments/planning/index.php): Planning and Zoning: rezoning, development, regulations, and city growth planning.
- [Zoning Department](https://northcharleston.org/business/zoning/index.php): Zoning Department: classifications, verification, enforcement, and interactive maps.
- [Code Enforcement and Neighborhood Enhancement](https://northcharleston.org/government/city_departments/code_enforcement/index.php): Code Enforcement and Neighborhood Enhancement Team: ordinances and property maintenance.

## Finance, Procurement & Business Services

- [Finance Department](https://northcharleston.org/government/city_departments/finance/index.php): Finance Department: budgets, business licenses, taxes, and payment information.
- [Procurement Department](https://northcharleston.org/government/city_departments/procurement/index.php): Procurement Department: vendor management, bids, RFPs, and government purchasing.

## Public Works & Community Services

- [Public Works](https://northcharleston.org/government/city_departments/public_works/index.php): Public Works: garbage collection, recycling, maintenance, and service requests.

## Recreation, Culture & Community Programs

- [Parks & Recreation](https://recreation.northcharleston.org): Parks & Recreation: aquatics, youth sports, programs, and facility registration.
- [Cultural Arts](https://culturalarts.northcharleston.org): North Charleston Cultural Arts: classes, gallery exhibits, and community programs.

## Employment & Human Resources

- [Human Resources](https://northcharleston.org/government/city_departments/human_resources/index.php): Human Resources: city job applications, employment vacancies, and hiring process.
